about: Copilot 3.2 LIVE held-out questions, written on 2026-10-16 after the verifier existed but WITHOUT running it on any answer to them. None appears in explain_dataset.json or visualization_dataset.json (new amounts, periods, warehouses, phrasings). Decision-heavy on purpose: budgets, counts, periods, warehouse comparisons, recommendations, plus a few bait questions (optimality, causality).
